symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The driver contains fixed-seed and F5 calculations. It defines no psi_3 evaluator, signed divisor-enumeration routine or halving/Mazur decision routine, and imports no such routine from its two reused sources.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The source asserts integer/congruence/short-model conditions and constructs the 25-pair F5 list. The report carries theorem_required as a string; no proof implementation of the named imported theorems is present.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: All-positive-n strict reconstruction, primitive-scale divisibility and infinite image
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: primitive_reconstruct checks its concrete input and parent root readback. main samples exactly (1,2,3) and asserts three distinct sextuples. No universal-n induction, bound ceil(N/8), or universally quantified primitive-normalization proof is encoded.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: Per-core infinitude/rank equivalence and future-operation observer scope
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: No rank computation or equivalence-proof routine is present. The targeted dropped-scale/dropped-sign controls inspect the second sample; the remaining report statements are retained data/scope strings.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: Arbitrary ordered-core reduction, genus-one/smoothness argument and signed-cover multiplicity
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The driver fixes A,C and triangle discriminants numerically. It contains no arbitrary-core smoothness/gradient or genus routine and no preimage-count routine for the signed cover or positive-d slice.
The source checks seed membership, prime-11/divisibility values and the denominator of a computed double; the named theorem is a report method string, with no theorem proof implementation.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: All-odd-multiple square-class preservation and exceptional-domain induction
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The symbolic routine performs exactly expand((f-(m*x+z)**2).subs(x,e)+(m*e+z)**2)==0 for e1,e2,e3. The sample loop checks rational squares for n=(1,3,5,7,9,11). No square-class data type or all-odd induction routine is present.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: Universal c=1 primitive normalization, arbitrary scaling, and injectivity of all positive odd n
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The source calculates a root-denominator lcm and validates parent gcd/factors/swap for each supplied sample; it asserts distinct d_over_b values for the six rows. It has no universally quantified minimality, arbitrary-scale or all-positive-odd injectivity proof routine.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: Complete Euclid equal-area parameter equation and residual global classification
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The imported normal-form routine checks a supplied integer datum. The current family driver has no arbitrary pair of Euclid parameter triples or solver for the global equal-area/zero-column equations. Historical parent census routines are not called by this driver.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: Exhaustiveness of fixed-core zero-column candidate lists
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: boundary_checks starts from the literal dictionary {210:[3,44],0:[4,33],-210:[11,12]}, checks listed values, then asserts admissible d list [3]. It contains no polynomial solver or symbolic derivation of the candidate-list completeness.

formula compares two arithmetic expressions on each input. main uses stored rows plus explicitly bounded artificial p/q/r/s values. It contains no prime-factor/valuation loop or symbolic proof of the parity restrictions, general valuation cases or all valid scales.

symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.author_statement_label: Observer preservation for listed future operations
symbolic_claims_without_matching_univers.static_code_boundary: The driver stores sample point/sign/scale/root data and asserts sample factor swaps. It defines no general future-operation quotient/observer compatibility proof routine.
